what_this_is: A lookup classifier scoring 1 for "sequence seen anywhere in training" and 0 otherwise, using no sequence features. It measures what the dataset construction gives away, not what the network learns.
tie_convention_note: The score takes two values, so most test rows tie. train_cnn.average_precision sorts with kind="stable", breaking that tie by file order: deterministic but arbitrary. The random-tiebreak figure is the convention-free quantity. Quote that one.
interval_note: Nominal-99% cluster bootstrap over the 10 held-out participants (D008). R6 measured nominal-95% delivering 0.884-0.890 actual coverage at this unit count, which is why nominal-99% is used and why no 99% confidence is claimed.
what_this_does_not_show: That the network exploits this shortcut. The oracle shows the shortcut exists and is exploitable; attributing any part of the endpoint to it would need an experiment this is not.
